content: Screen-time/digital-wellbeing apps for kids & families: Forest (focus timer gamification - tree grows during focus, dies if you leave; app blocking, Time Guard schedules, stats, real tree planting; parents use it as family 'game you can only win by not playing'; Internet Matters reviewed). Awarely (intent-first: on opening a tracked app asks 'how long?', floating countdown, weekly insights, no hard blocks - 'intentional scrolling not restriction'). freii (Villa Schöpflin, 11-15y, 21-day web-app prevention program: 4 guides, daily videos + mostly-offline challenges, quizzes, points, fully anonymous, separate parent version, school setting, scientifically evaluated per SWR/Ärzteblatt; goal explicit: not demonize media). Android Digital Wellbeing (app timers, Bedtime mode w/ grayscale) and iOS Screen Time (limits, downtime) = OS-level parental control. Trend: awareness+intention > restriction; gamification rewards offline action, not engagement.
